|game_text=Deploy on table with up to 15 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play [[Recoil In Fear]] until the end of your first turn.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-29E-Knowledge_And_Defense-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-29E-Knowledge_And_Defense.png]]) show the original text (see [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 29E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table with up to 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”).<ref name="cl-1240_31-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “up to 12 cards” to “up to 15 cards” (slip marked E): “Deploy on table with up to 15 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
